name: itsuki
description: One private memory for every AI. Loads project memory when a session starts, saves decisions and fixes when it ends, and bundles the memory tools — with receipts for every write.

metadata.setup: Set ITSUKI_API_KEY in your shell profile (create one at https://itsuki.app → API keys) — the session hooks need it. Optionally set ITSUKI_MCP_URL to an MCP link for the in-session memory tools.
